## Frameworks

1. [React](https://react.dev)
2. [Angular](https://angular.io)
3. [Solid.js](https://solidjs.com)
4. [Vue](https://vuejs.org)
5. [Svelte](https://svelte.dev)

## Static

1. [Docusaurus](https://docusaurus.io)
2. [VitePress](https://vitepress.dev)
3. [Astro](https://astro.build)

## Meta

1. [Next.js](https://nextjs.org)
2. [SolidStart](https://solidjs.com/docs/latest/guides/solid-start)
3. [Nuxt](https://nuxt.com)
4. [SvelteKit](https://kit.svelte.dev)

## Styling

1. [TailwindCSS](https://tailwindcss.com)
2. [Bootstrap](https://getbootstrap.com)

## [[ui-components|UI Components]]

1. [DaisyUI](https://daisyui.com)
2. [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com)

## State Management

1. [Zustand](https://zustand.dev)
2. [Jotai](https://jotai.dev)
3. [Redux](https://redux.js.org)
4. [MobX](https://mobx.js.org)

## Hybrid

### Mobile

1. [Capacitor](https://capacitorjs.com)
2. [Ionic](https://ionicframework.com)
3. [React Native](https://reactnative.dev)
4. [Expo](https://expo.dev)
5. [Lynx](https://lynx.dev)
6. [Flutter](https://flutter.dev)

### Desktop

1. [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org/)
2. [Tauri](https://tauri.app)
3. [Wails](https://wails.io)
